Do not re-derive the k^2/N draw arithmetic or propose different N and k targets; those are established, and only their consequences for palette function coverage are in scope here.
Do not rule on pace-layer placement, decadent-versus-destitute register, the title slot word, or the parked conflicting-accounts question; surface forced moves and stop.

decision_lens: Run every candidate domain through five admission questions in order, spending no more than a minute: (1) DOSAGE RANGE — over how wide a range of prominence does the domain remain usable? A domain that only works when it is the whole subject of a book is a soliflore, not a palette material, and it cannot appear in a k=10-14 draw ten times without being the book each time. (2) FACET COUNT UNDER CONTEXT — how many distinct readings does it present across the 3 traditions, and are any two of them opposed? This is P4 made countable rather than asserted, and it is checkable against opposed senses already recorded in de Vries and Cooper. (3) FUNCTION — does it lift, fill, or fix? A pool with no fixative-class domains generates books with nothing holding them together. (4) REPETITION SURVIVAL — does the twentieth appearance still register, or is the interest entirely in the first encounter? (5) BLOTTER-SKIN GAP — is the appeal in the concept as described to mk, or in the text a player reads? Where the answer to any question is an assertion rather than a count, name the computation over the corpora on disk that would turn it into a count, and prefer a weak metric that runs today over a strong one that does not.
distance_rationale: Perfumery has no shared vocabulary, literature, tooling, or personnel with procedural generation, symbol scholarship, or game design, yet it is the profession that has spent three centuries on precisely this brief's unsolved problem: choosing a bounded working palette from a very large materia when per-material cost is real, when a material's value is not its solo appeal but what it does in combination, and when the person choosing is the least reliable judge of the result. It is the only distant field that operationalised the brief's P1 rather than asserting it — 'yield' exists there as dosage range, facet count, and odor value, all measurable — and the only one whose core professional pathology is exactly the brief's section 7.3 worry: perfumers systematically overvalue materials that are interesting on a blotter in the lab and undervalue the dull fixatives that make a composition last on a wearer, which is legibility-to-the-author versus interest-to-the-player under a different name and with a known correction protocol.
expected_isomorphisms: Diction yield (P1) maps to dosage range and facet count — how wide a range of prominence a material stays usable across, and how many distinct readings it presents within that range; both countable, neither identical to 'how much prose I can think of', which perfumery calls familiarity, not richness. P4's contradiction property maps to the dilution flip: the trade's most valued materials are the ones that read oppositely at trace versus strength, so P4 is not exotic but predictable — and countable as opposed senses inside one de Vries or Cooper entry. P2's two-corpus attestation maps to two suppliers listing the same material: evidence of commercial supply and of shared sourcing, not of performance in a formula. P3's material-versus-abstract fork maps to naturals versus abstractions, a fork perfumery abandoned because abstractions do work that naturals cannot. The N=60-80 master pool maps to the organ, and k=10-14 per seed to formula length, with the perfumer's caution that a formula of ten headline materials and no fixative evaporates. The 'recognising a domain recur across books' half of question 1 maps to the house signature accord and to repetition survival — the property that decides whether recurrence reads as identity or as sameness. Slice v0's 17 hand-written accounts map to a reference set for blind evaluation. The 3-tradition multiplier maps to formulation cost, and shared diction fragments to pre-composed bases, with their known homogenising cost.
focus: Whether the brief's central axis, diction yield, names a property of the symbol or an artifact of mk's familiarity — and whether the framework carries any evaluation protocol capable of telling those apart before 180-720 lines of unscrapeable diction have been written against the wrong ranking.
name: fd-perfumery-accordyield
persona: Apply the perspective of a perfumer specifying the working organ for a house under a fixed materials budget. This reviewer does not ask whether a material is beautiful. It asks over what dosage range the material stays usable, how many distinct characters it presents across that range, what it does to the other things in the formula, whether it still registers on the twentieth exposure, what it costs per unit and how much of it a formula must carry to be perceptible, and whether the impression that survives on skin after six hours is the one that impressed on the blotter. It has watched colleagues build palettes that are self-portraits of their own training, and treats a palette assembled from memory without a blind check as an unfinished piece of work rather than a controversial one. It takes seriously that fixatives are dull, non-negotiable, and always the first thing cut by someone ranking materials on interest. It knows that the nose that composed the formula is the nose least able to smell it, and that the correction for this is protocol, not care.
review_areas: P1 operationalisation: propose concrete computable surrogates for diction yield and say which files and fields they read — distinct numbered senses in the de Vries entry in /Users/sma/projects/mythref-text/ad-de-vries-dictionary-of-symbols-and-imagery.md, distinct source works per slug in the census registry, distinct collocate nouns in the Cooper text, essay presence in the ARAS index — and rank them by how much of the variance they can plausibly explain versus how cheap they are to run. Then state the falsification test explicitly: mk ranks 20 named domains by yield from memory, the corpus metric is computed afterward, and the correlation is reported. A P1 that survives this is measured; a P1 that is not tested this way is a self-portrait.

P4 made countable: whether 'supports contradiction' can be read off the corpora as opposed senses within a single entry, and whether contradiction is a property of the symbol at all or a property of how the 3 traditions were specified — under the second reading almost any domain supports contradiction once the traditions are opposed, which would empty P4 of ranking power. Include the dosage question P4 ignores: whether a domain's opposed readings survive being drawn at low prominence, or whether contradiction only works when the domain is the book's subject.

The repetition axis and question 1's decomposition: which of READING, RECOGNISING, and ADJUDICATING each candidate metric actually serves; which domains are novelty materials that fascinate once and are inert at the twentieth encounter; and how a house signature accord — a small always-present subset — differs structurally from a large pool of interchangeable draws, including what that implies for the k=10-14 per-seed draw.

Evaluation protocol runnable by one person: a concrete blind procedure using slice v0's 17 hand-written accounts as a calibration set and generated text stripped of domain labels, with a stated delay before re-reading, so the framework's output can be checked against reader response rather than against mk's agreement with it. Name what this costs in hours and what it can detect that self-scoring cannot.

Palette function coverage: identify the fixative class — domains that are dull in isolation but hold a book together — and show what a pure top-N-by-interest ranking does to them. State which of the 312 ARAS candidates plausibly occupy each role and what a functional quota (n fixatives, n modifiers) would do to the framework's simplicity and to the under-a-minute constraint.

Cost per material and the base analogy: whether shared diction fragments reused across domains and traditions are the perfumery base — a real economy with a known homogenising cost — and where the 3-tradition multiplier makes a domain unaffordable at any yield. Include the recurring-cost question: which diction must be rewritten when a fourth tradition is added or a tradition's position drifts under schools.rs canon-formation.

severity_examples.condition: whenever P1 is retained as the leading axis without a named computation and a stated falsification test comparing mk's from-memory ranking against a corpus measurement
severity_examples.scenario: The framework's primary axis is diction yield scored by mk from memory with no blind protocol attached, so the 60-domain pool is selected by mk's familiarity distribution rather than by any property of the symbols; because diction is the unscrapeable layer, the error is only detectable after 180-720 lines have been written, and the corrective is a full rewrite of the pool rather than a re-sort.

severity_examples.condition: when the framework outputs a single scalar score per candidate with no functional role quota and no test of what a k=10-14 draw from the resulting pool actually contains
severity_examples.scenario: The pool is selected by top-N interest, so every admitted domain is a headline material and no fixative-class domain survives the cut; generated books read as lists of vivid nouns with nothing holding them across paragraphs, and the recurrence that is supposed to make two seeds feel like one universe reads as repetition instead of signature.

severity_examples.condition: when a proposed computation is not checked against the shape of the file it reads, particularly where a corpus has been editorially normalised to uniform length
severity_examples.scenario: Yield is operationalised as definition length in symbols.yaml, which is a property of that file's normalisation pipeline — its definitions are uniformly one to two sentences — rather than of the symbol, so the metric computes cleanly, correlates with nothing, and lends measured-looking authority to an arbitrary order.

source_domain: Perfumery composition and raw-material palette selection — the perfumer's organ as a working set of 60-100 materials cut from thousands of available naturals, absolutes, and aromachemicals; the quantitative surrogates the trade actually uses (odor detection threshold and odor value, substantivity measured in blotter-hours, tenacity versus diffusion, the usable dosage range of a material in percent); facet behaviour, where one material presents opposite characters at different dilutions (indole floral at trace and fecal at strength, civet, costus, cumin, oakmoss); functional roles in a formula (top, heart, base, fixative, modifier, blender, bridge); pre-composed bases such as Mousse de Saxe and Prunol that package several materials into one reusable sub-assembly; the brief; evaluation discipline — blotter versus skin versus maceration, the panel, controlled re-smelling at delay, anosmia and familiarity fatigue in the perfumer's own nose; house signature accords carried across a whole line (the Guerlainade); and reformulation under IFRA restriction, where a palette must be rebuilt when the supply of a material changes.
success_hints: State every metric as a runnable computation that names the file and the field it reads, and say roughly what it costs to run; a metric without a path is an opinion with a number attached.
Report facet and opposed-sense counts rather than adjectives — replace 'rich' and 'thin' with an integer and the entry the integer came from.
Separate the material's property from the perfumer's familiarity in every claim about yield, and propose the blind check that would tell them apart rather than asserting which is operating.
Give the fixative class real names from the 312-essay index rather than describing it abstractly, so mk can see what a pure interest ranking would discard.

Where P4 is at stake, say whether contradiction is being measured on the symbol or manufactured by how the 3 traditions were specified, and note explicitly where selecting for contradiction would pre-commit the parked conflicting-accounts question without ruling that question.

Keep the recommended framework to gates a person can run in under a minute per candidate, and state which gates are automatable batch computations run once over the whole pool rather than per-candidate judgments.
task_context: Produce a prioritization FRAMEWORK — a ranking function or ordered gate sequence applicable to any candidate domain in under a minute, not a curated list — for which archetypal domains to develop first in Rakes of the New Book, a dying-earth game whose primary content is procedurally generated BOOKS, optimizing for the most interesting/fun stories. Attack the brief's positions P1-P5 individually, hardest on P1 (diction yield — unmeasured, the brief's favorite) and P4 (prefer domains supporting contradiction — least tested, but the only position derived from Rakes' own extension rather than inherited from Caves of Qud). FIVE QUESTIONS in priority order: (1) What does 'interesting/fun stories' actually decompose into for a game whose content is texts nobody is forced to read — is the fun in READING a generated book, RECOGNIZING a domain recur across books, ADJUDICATING between traditions that read the same object oppositely, or something none of these name? Any framework optimizing an unnamed proxy is a failure. (2) Is this a RANKING problem or a COVERING problem — settle the brief's section 5 question of whether a domain is a tag, a position, or a denotation set, or show it is underdetermined and name the specific measurement that would settle it. jawnomicon's MEASURED finding is that a symbol's content is a denotation set, not a position, which if true means top-N ranking is the wrong algorithm and set-covering is right. (3) Kill or confirm P1-P5 individually. (4) Which axes are COMPUTABLE from corpora already on disk versus irreducibly taste — concrete computations over the 312-essay ARAS index (docs/fixtures/aras-domain-candidates.md), jawnomicon symbols.yaml (950 entries at /Users/sma/projects/jawnomicon/data/vocab/symbols.yaml), the 4839-row census registry (/Users/sma/projects/jawnomicon/data/census/registry/), the raw de Vries and Cooper full texts in /Users/sma/projects/mythref-text/, and slice v0's 17 hand-written accounts. A weaker metric that actually computes beats a stronger one that cannot. (5) Where does a proposed framework optimize for LEGIBILITY TO THE AUTHOR (mk) rather than INTEREST TO THE PLAYER? These come apart and the brief admits it cannot tell them apart.
